title: The Lantern Beneath the Ice
visual_style: cohesive illustrated cinematic 9:16, same young rust-red fox with white muzzle and teal scarf in every scene, realistic winter lighting, no text baked into images

story_beats.speech: At dusk, a young fox crossing the snowy lakeshore noticed a golden light drifting beneath the frozen surface. It stopped whenever she stopped, as though someone below was trying to get her attention.
story_beats.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic illustration, young rust-red fox with white muzzle and teal scarf on a snow-covered lake shore at blue hour, faint golden moving glow beneath thick translucent ice, pine forest silhouettes, wide safe margins, consistent character design, no lettering.

story_beats.speech: She followed the glow to a ring of old metal bolts frozen into the ice. Three flashes, a pause, then three more. The light wasn't an animal. Someone was sending a signal.
story_beats.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 illustrated close-to-mid view, same fox kneeling beside translucent ice, visible ring of weathered bolts embedded beneath frost, three warm golden pulses from below, fox alert and concerned, believable scale, no lettering.

story_beats.speech: Beneath the lake stood a forgotten research station. Its emergency beacon had failed, so the trapped researcher was using a handheld lantern to flash through the station's glass roof.
story_beats.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 underwater cutaway illustration of old compact scientific observation station beneath frozen lake, researcher silhouette inside shining warm lantern through glass roof, ice overhead, blue-green water, same geography as prior scenes, no lettering.

story_beats.speech: The fox raced to the ranger cabin and led a rescue team back to the bolts. They opened the station's emergency hatch and brought the researcher safely into the cold night. The smallest light had shown the way.
